jobDescription:

The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Job Overview :

Booking Holdings India is a Center of Excellence (COE) based in Bangalore, India and was created to support the increasing business demands of Booking Holdings Inc. and its Brands. The COE is a key enabler of Booking Holdings Inc.’s global talent strategy for several technology functions such as Cybersecurity, Fraud monitoring/analytics, IT, and others across our Brand subsidiaries.

 

At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

 

Booking.com follows a defence‑in‑depth strategy for managing its risks, with three lines of defence. Global Internal Audit (GIA) is responsible for the 3rd line, Risk & Controls (R&C) for the 2nd line, while the 1st line risk responsibilities for Central Tech and Security, Safety & Fraud (SS&F) are embedded in business teams and the Tech Risk Operations group.

 

The GRC Engineering Manager leads a team of engineers responsible for building, operating and continuously improving the technology, data and automation that underpin our governance, risk and compliance (GRC) capabilities.

 

The role will be key to defining the “next generation” SS&F and CT operational risk management practices using GenAI in the core, ensuring smart and pragmatic regulatory compliance and risk based decision making. 

About the Role

To help us accelerate on this journey, we are looking for an Engineering Manager to join our team. The GRC Principal Engineer provides technical leadership for the technology, data and automation that underpin governance, risk and compliance (GRC) capabilities, driving architectural direction, engineering standards and cross-functional execution.

 

You will provide technical mentorship, guidance and thought leadership across engineering teams, helping raise engineering quality, technical capability and delivery effectiveness in alignment with organizational objectives.

You should be a role model, technically strong to help your team develop and be able to be hands-on when needed. The GRC Senior Engineer drives the technical direction of critical engineering initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, secure and aligned with business objectives.. The role holder is required to analyze technology trends, human talent needs, and market demand to plan projects to ensure resilience in line with current demand and future ambition.

 

In addition to this, the role will confer with leaders, product, and key stakeholders to determine engineering feasibility, cost effectiveness, scalability, and time-to-market for new and existing products.

 

B.Responsible

1. Leadership & Strategy

  • Define the GRC engineering vision, roadmap and operating model, aligned with security, risk and business strategy.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship across engineering teams, establishing engineering standards, promoting technical excellence, and helping engineers grow through coaching, design reviews and knowledge sharing.

  • Act as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders in Tech Risk Operations, as well as 2nd line Risk.  

  • Champion a culture of automation, data-driven decision making and continuous improvement in how we manage risk and compliance.

2. GRC Platform & Tooling Ownership

  • Own the GRC technology stack (e.g. GRC platform, risk & controls inventory, evidence management, reporting).

  • Design and oversee integrations between GRC tooling and core systems (e.g. CI/CD, cloud platforms, identity, ticketing tools such as Jira/ServiceNow, data platforms).

  • Ensure the GRC platform supports end-to-end workflows for risk assessments, control design, testing, issues and remediation.

  • Drive scalability and reliability of GRC tooling, including access control, performance, availability and data quality.

3. Control & Compliance Automation

  • Translate requirements from frameworks such as NIST, PCI-DSS, SOX, GDPR, NIS2, EU AI/DSA/DMA into technical patterns and guardrails.

  • Lead the design and implementation of control-as-code / policy-as-code and automated checks in CI/CD, cloud, and application environments.

  • Identify manual compliance bottlenecks and lead initiatives to automate evidence collection, reporting and testing using scripting, APIs and workflow engines.

  • Partner with security engineering and platform teams to ensure security and compliance are baked into standard platform offerings.

4. Collaboration with Audit, Security & Compliance Functions

  • Oversee technical risk assessments for new platforms, major architectural changes and high-risk initiatives.

  • Act as a bridge between engineering teams and internal/external audit, helping translate technical designs into risk and control language.

  • Support audit and assurance cycles (e.g. SOX, PCI, ISO 27001, SOC 2) by ensuring GRC tooling can surface reliable evidence.

  • Partner with Legal, Privacy and Security to operationalise new regulatory requirements into sustainable engineering and process changes.

5. Ways of Working & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and refine standards, patterns, runbooks and documentation for GRC engineering solutions.

  • Define and track KPIs (e.g. control automation coverage, time-to-remediate, number of manual attestations replaced by automation).

  • Continuously improve methodologies for risk assessment, control design and testing to keep pace with evolving technologies and regulations.

B.Skilled

Level of Education : Bachelor or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, Business, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications (e.g. CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, cloud certifications) are a plus.

 


Years of relevant Job Knowledge : Extensive Knowledge (8-12 years)

 


Requirements of special knowledge/skills

  • 8-12 years of relevant job experience, with previous experience in people management 

  • Strong technical skills (coding & system design) and a deep understanding of software development in a team, as well as a track record of developing and shipping software

  • Inspire and motivate multiple cross functional product teams

  • Lead by example by taking ownership, being proactive, and collaborating

  • Foster a great culture that innovates, work together as a team, partner with other Booking.com teams and roles, and celebrates unified success

  • Respects the Booking.com values and uses them as a guide to the way we work

  • Mastery in technology leadership including shaping ways of working

  • Engineering delivery, quality, and practices within own team including delivery management

  • Delivery of the wider Engineering strategic objectives

  • Embed Agile ways of working and values within the organization

  • Get into the technical detail where required to coach, support, and mentor the team

  • Engineering Craftsmanship including coaching and mentoring the team

  • Adhere to the default principles for Architecture, quality, and non-functional requirements

  • Drive a culture of ownership and technical excellence, including reactive work such as incident escalations

  • Learn new technologies and keep abreast of existing technologies and be able to share learning’s and apply these to a variety of projects as applicable

  • Thought partner for Product to define, shape, and deliver the roadmap

  • Build new products, processes, and operational plans

  • Negotiate on the strategic importance of own product roadmap features

  • Drive innovation in own team

  • Own the architecture across own team

  • This role may be required to work on an on-call rotation

  • 5 - 9 years of Software Design and Development Experience in integration and related technologies. 

  • In Depth Hands-on knowledge of SAP Convergent Mediation (CM) with abilities to design and build Workflows.

  • Ability to build scalable solutions in SAP CM and supporting Logging, Tracing and Alerting with various tools.

  • Ability to use version control tools like git and GitLab with CM is highly preferred.

  • Building monitoring Dashboards using Loki, Grafana, Prometheus etc

  • Knowledge of building Unit, Integration and Automation tests using SAP CM is highly desirable. 

  • Deep experience in working with Large data sources with ability to build a scalable CM solution using Kafka, REST API, File/FTP and Database sources.

  • Processing and Decoding different UDRs and being able to use data formats like Avro.

  • Creating Co-relations, Processing the relevant inputs and generating BITs for SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI) and FICA.

Join us to innovate fearlessly, build connected experiences, and help shape the future of global travel and hospitality. Are you ready to be part of a journey that makes the world more accessible for everyone?

 

About the team:

The Data & AI Governance department enables extending the governance theme of policies, standards, processes and technology for governing data and AI to driving excellence in our approach to leveraging secure, trusted, accessible data for data driven decision making through:

  • An overarching Data & AI Policy to include associated standards

  • Data & AI Governance including meta and master data management

  • Data & AI Delivery Governance

  • Data & AI Quality including both technical and business quality measures

This enables the maturity of Data and AI capabilities across Booking.com, unlocking data and algorithms as assets for delivering innovative growth opportunities and cost saving operational efficiencies. 

Role Description: We are looking for a Data & AI Governance Configuration Manager to join our Data & AI Governance organisation, managing a team of individual contributors and contractors on and off shore. The Configuration Manager must have demonstrated experience in leading and motivating a team of analysts and specialists (up to 5-7 people) in addition to demonstrated experience in managing large cross-organizational Data & AI Governance initiatives. Ideal candidates should have a technical background in Data & AI Governance Standards & Frameworks, Data Ownership & Stewardship, Risk Management, Regulatory Change, and Business Operations and various Data Governance tools. They must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means not only being able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up their sleeves, dig in and help drive change.

This role is a mix of leadership (leading a small team of specialists and analysts) individual contributors, and it demands skills as an evangelist and a partner - at a time where transformation and modernisation of our data ecosystem is a company-wide priority.

 

Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:  

People Management:

  • Manage a team of Data and AI Governance operations specialists and potentially contractors including ensuring people’s performance and wellbeing is balanced

  • Help set up quarterly and yearly objectives, estimate work, manage team and personal performance reviews

  • Mentor and coach team members

  • Improve team routines and processes for better performance based on the state of the team. Ensure the team follows the best practices to learn and adopt new methodologies

  • Manage hiring and compensation

  • Help the team to communicate externally and internally, resolve conflicts

Data and AI Governance:

  • Data Stewardship: Manage the ease of use and access for Data Ownership and Stewardship roles and responsibilities across tools, supporting clear accountability and proper onboarding of data stewards with intuitive user journeys.

  • Data & AI Governance Principles: Apply and enforce Data & AI Governance principles, processes, policies, and standards to ensure consistent and effective governance practices.

  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to Data & AI regulatory policies, such as GDPR, DMA, SOx, and the EU AI Act, by staying updated on compliance requirements and integrating them into governance frameworks and implementation practices. 

  • Data & AI Governance Practices: Drive the adoption of Data & AI Governance capabilities including Data & AI Literacy, data cataloging, data profiling, metadata management, data classification, data lineage, master data management, and workflows, ensuring robust governance of critical data elements.

  • Work with the broader Data & AI Governance team to ensure the continuous roll out of improvements and evolution of compliance controls to ensure the continual maturity of Data & AI Practice at Booking.

Configuration Management: 

  • Metadata Management: be responsible for working with Data & AI Governance SMEs, Architecture, Product and Engineering teams to ensure appropriate metadata configuration and management including continuous improvement opportunities.

  • E2E Delivery & Impact: Contribute to high-complexity Data & AI governance agile delivery and high-impact initiatives independently - leading metadata design execution, testing and reporting, and final handover to business-as-usual operations.

  • Stakeholder Management: Act as an authoritative point of contact for metadata management inquiries. You must navigate a complex stakeholder landscape, effectively engaging with cross-functional working groups and presenting strategic updates to leadership up to the VP level.

  • Risk Management: Identify, assess, track and mitigate issues and risks at multiple levels

  • Operational Excellence: Expertly leverage the Atlassian suite (Jira/Confluence) to architect delivery workflows, track configuration changes, and maintain transparent documentation. You will ensure the team’s output is measurable, visible, and aligned with departmental velocity goals.

  • Change Leadership: Champion the department’s change management protocols. You will guide your team through technical transitions and organizational shifts, ensuring that new governance processes are adopted smoothly without disrupting the broader data community.

Experience Requirements:

  • 5-8 years of relevant technical experience, with 3+ years focused around Data Governance (or 5+ years in a broader Data/Analytical role)):

    • SDLC for Governance: Applying "Data Governance as Code" principles—using Git for version control of configuration scripts and managing Test, Staging, and Production environments.

jobDescription:
Senior Enterprise Application Engineer

Experience required: 10+ years overall IT, with 7+ years on the ServiceNow platform
 Role type: Senior individual contributor / technical role
 Reports to: Engineering Manager, ServiceNow Platform

 

 

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Enterprise Application Engineer with the ability to direct our ITAM and ITSM landscape, with platform-wide architecture accountability. This is a senior, hands-on role: you will own the end-to-end design for IT Asset Management (HAM Pro and SAM Pro) and ITSM, ensure both are architected cleanly against our CMDB and CSDM, and govern how the platform evolves across integrations, performance, and operability.

You will be the technical steward who signs off solution designs, holds standards across the team, and represents the platform's interests when working with vendors, business stakeholders, and other engineering teams.

 

 

What you will own

ITAM architecture and delivery

You will own the ITAM domain on the ServiceNow platform — This includes asset lifecycle design from planning through disposal, software licence position and entitlement modelling across major publishers (Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, VMware), contract and reclamation workflows, normalisation and reconciliation at scale, and audit-defence-ready compliance posture. You will design and operate Service Graph Connectors (SCCM, Intune, Jamf, Tanium, Entra, AWS, and similar) to feed ITAM and CMDB with trustworthy data.

ITSM architecture and platform stewardship

You will architect ITSM end-to-end — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge — ensuring processes are aligned to ITIL practice but pragmatic to the business. You will rationalise customisations toward out-of-the-box where appropriate, set standards for how the ITSM team builds and operates, and ensure CMDB/CSDM alignment so ITSM, ITOM, and ITAM share a coherent data model.

Platform administration and governance

You will set and enforce platform governance — scoping policy, naming conventions, update set hygiene, technical debt management, upgrade strategy, and performance standards. You will participate in or lead the Technical Governance Board, review and sign off solution designs from internal teams and vendors, and own the platform health and upgrade roadmap.

Integrations

You will architect integrations to and from ServiceNow — REST and SOAP web services, Integration Hub spokes, OAuth and SAML flows, MID Server design, Service Graph Connectors, and event-driven patterns. You will define integration standards, error-handling and retry patterns, and the credentialing and secrets-management approach.

Technical mentorship

You will provide technical mentorship to mid-level and junior engineers in the team, review designs and code, and represent the platform's voice in vendor engagements — including reviewing vendor-produced BRDs and signing off vendor solution designs from a platform-fit and operability perspective.

 

 

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Lead solution design workshops for ITAM, ITSM, and cross-module initiatives, producing solution design documents that meet platform standards.

  • Configure, develop, and where needed extend HAM Pro and SAM Pro to match the organisation's licence and hardware estate, including publisher packs, normalisation rules, and reconciliation logic.

  • Drive CMDB and CSDM health — class model, identification and reconciliation rules, discovery patterns, data quality KPIs.

  • Set up and operate Service Graph Connectors and other ITAM data sources; troubleshoot data quality and reconciliation issues end-to-end.

  • Design and implement complex integrations using REST, SOAP, Integration Hub, MID Server, OAuth, and SAML.

  • Provide technical sign-off on solution designs — internal and vendor-produced — for ITAM, ITSM, and platform-impacting work.

  • Define and enforce technical governance: scoped applications, naming, update sets, code review standards, upgrade readiness.

  • Mentor engineers, run technical deep-dives, and uplift the team's capability in ServiceNow.

  • Stay current on the ServiceNow roadmap, especially AI features (NowAssist, AI Control Tower) and emerging ITAM capabilities, and bring practical adoption proposals.

 

 

Must-have skills and experience

  • 10+ years overall IT experience, with 7+ years on ServiceNow in delivery and architecture roles.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in ITAM — both HAM and SAM — including lifecycle design, licence position management, reconciliation at scale, and audit-defence experience.

  • Strong ITSM architecture experience — Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge — and the maturity to push back on customisation where OOB is right.

  • Solid CMDB and CSDM architecture experience — class model, identification rules, IRE behaviour, data quality governance.

  • Proven integrations experience — REST, SOAP, Integration Hub, OAuth, SAML, MID Server, Service Graph Connectors (SCCM/Intune/Jamf/Tanium/Entra/AWS or equivalents).

  • Strong platform administration depth — scopes, update sets, ACLs, performance tuning, upgrade strategy.

  • Hands-on coding in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Scripted REST APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes.

  • Demonstrated ability to write and review solution design documents and sign off as a technical authority.

  • Strong stakeholder communication and the credibility to challenge vendors and business stakeholders constructively.

Certifications

Required: ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
 Strongly preferred: ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist in SAM, HAM, ITSM, Discovery (any two or more).
 Bonus: Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or Certified Master Architect (CMA). ITIL 4 Foundation or above.

Nice to have

  • ITOM Discovery and Service Mapping hands-on experience.

  • Experience with AI features in the platform (NowAssist, AI Control Tower) and a view on practical adoption.

  • Experience leading vendor handovers and hypercare transitions.

  • Experience in regulated industries (finance, healthcare, telecom) or large-scale enterprise estates (100+ software publishers, complex licence positions).

This is a role with genuine platform accountability. The right person will shape how a 9-person team delivers across ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, GRC and WSD, and how vendor-delivered work integrates cleanly into a long-lived platform.
